text: {"name":"get_radio_context_if_ready","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns the stored radio context only when exactly one of the two state bytes is set and the context flag at offset 106 is clear.","subsystem":"hal","var_renames":{"result":"radio_context"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":8,"meaning":"Pointer to the radio context returned by this function."},{"offset":17,"meaning":"One of two state bytes checked together; their values must sum to one."},{"offset":18,"meaning":"One of two state bytes checked together; their values must sum to one."},{"offset":106,"meaning":"Context flag that must be clear for the context to be returned."}]}
